messages:
Sophie Chen: heads-up — we need a short, customer-facing update for a subset of EU accounts experiencing higher error rates and delayed onboarding jobs after last night's autoscaler spike. affected: ~120 tenants, mostly small trials in eu-west. want to push a note in the next 30m. :alarm_clock:
Liam Patel: +1. do we have a clear mitigation/ETA? customers will ask about credits/renewal impact. :eyes:
Anya Kuznetsova: quick tech summary for CS: last night at ~00:12 UTC a burst of allocation requests to our dedicated pools in eu-west hit a transient rate limit from the cloud provider -> autoscaler delayed pod provisioning and our fallback routing didn't trigger fast enough for some tenant queues. result: queued requests and intermittent 503s for embedding/onboard batch jobs. we've applied mitigations and are monitoring.
Anya Kuznetsova: mitigation steps taken: increased autoscaler scale-up aggressiveness for the affected pool, forced a rolling restart to clear stuck allocations, and pushed a routing-policy patch to accelerate cross-region fallback. cloud provider acknowledged transient capacity throttling and is provisioning additional capacity; they gave an initial ETA of ~3-6 hours for stabilization.
Carlos Rivera: thanks. can you give me a 2–3 sentence RCA and one-line recommended action for customers (so I can paste into an email)?
Anya Kuznetsova: RCA (short): a transient cloud allocation throttle in eu-west caused delayed GPU pool provisioning; this led to queued requests and some request timeouts during peak allocation. Recommended customer action (one-line): we recommend temporarily switching routing to our hosted eu fallback or enabling cross-region fallback in the Console until the provider capacity is stable.
Grace Li: drafted customer note suggestion (short):
"Hi — we’re investigating increased errors and delays for some onboarding jobs in EU. We’ve applied mitigations and recommend toggling cross-region fallback in the Console (or accept our hosted fallback) while we monitor. We’ll follow up with a timeline and root cause details. — Redwood CS"
Carlos Rivera: can we include the exact Console steps? that reduces support back-and-forth.
Anya Kuznetsova: Console steps (copy):
1) Console > Deployments > Your Deployment > Routing
2) Toggle: "Enable cross-region fallback" -> Set preference to "hosted-eu-fallback"
3) Save and confirm.
Or API snippet to set routing policy quickly via curl:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deployments/ROUTE_ID/routing" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"policy": "hosted-eu-fallback", "priority": ["eu-west","hosted-eu"]}'
```
Sophie Chen: great. Carlos — can you send a short, non-technical email to affected tenants with that copy + link to the support office hours? Also add note about credits if workload impacted.
Carlos Rivera: will do. draft below — please quick sanity check:
Subject: Update: temporary delays for EU onboarding jobs\Body: Hi — we’re reaching out about temporary delays/errors affecting some onboarding and embedding jobs in our EU region. We’ve applied mitigations and recommend enabling cross-region fallback in the Console or using our hosted EU fallback to restore throughput immediately. We’ll follow up with a full RCA and compensation details if you were impacted. If you’d like help toggling fallback or need immediate throughput, reply here and we’ll assist via live office hours: https://redwood.ai/office-hours
Sophie Chen: clean. add a short line: "No action required if you already see normal behavior."
Carlos Rivera: updated. sending now to the 120 affected tenants.
statusbot: Incident updated on status.redwood.ai: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rdw-eu-rateburst-2026 — mitigation applied, monitoring.
Liam Patel: any guidance for renewals team? should we flag accounts as renewal risk?
Sophie Chen: flag high-touch trials that had >30% job failure as outreach priority. renewals team: we’ll follow up with tailored credits where needed — Carlos, can you add a column in the outreach spreadsheet for "credit recommended"?
Carlos Rivera: yep adding now.
Anya Kuznetsova: postmortem notes to include: timeline of autoscaler throttle, cloud provider response, why routing fallback wasn't faster, and the code change that accelerates fallback. I’ll prepare the eng RCA draft in the next 12 hours.
Sophie Chen: perfect — once the eng RCA exists we’ll send a longer customer-facing RCA update. For now we did the short blast and CS triage. Thanks team. :pray:
Grace Li: posting a short KB later with screenshots for the Console steps and the curl example — will link in the follow-up message. :memo:
